title: Illustration / Overview

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Choose an illustration style that serves the idea, because attractive imagery must still help people understand the content.
strategic_value: Shared principles across line, flat and isometric styles can give IBM expressive range while keeping a recognizable aesthetic.
demonstration: The page pairs an illustration-film state with five principles and three illustrated style sections.
practical_value: Select line, flat or isometric treatment according to whether precision, graphic impact or spatial explanation best serves the subject.

content_islands.name: Purpose and film
content_islands.spec: Open with the Overview heading, explanation of illustration’s job and the captured purple face film state.

content_islands.name: Five principles
content_islands.spec: Stack Engineered, Clear, Nimble, Diverse and Delightful beside their explanatory text.

content_islands.name: Line specimens
content_islands.spec: Introduce precise linework with a gradient spiral and smaller circuit and finger examples.

content_islands.name: Flat specimens
content_islands.spec: Follow with a bold circle composition and eye and finger graphics.

content_islands.name: Isometric specimens
content_islands.spec: Close with spatial technology scenes on dark, teal and light backgrounds.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction explicitly says illustrations should support content and help users understand difficult concepts, products or services.
reference_purposes.Expression: Line, flat and isometric specimens demonstrate three distinct but related IBM treatments.
reference_purposes.Application: The style descriptions identify precision, bold graphic impact and spatial explanation as reasons to choose each approach.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The Clear principle says to retain essential, non-decorative elements; the Diverse principle requires considering gender, cultural and geographical representation.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
